verdict.rationale: HubSpot offers built-in AI agents (prospecting agent, deal progression, campaign planning from a goal, report generation via plain language) that act on behalf of users, plus an MCP server exposing CRM data to external AI agents. However, evidence is all vendor marketing copy with no independent/hands-on confirmation of a unified in-product 'assistant' that users delegate arbitrary tasks to, and no community verification of these AI agent features' reliability.
